Verified plan SHA-256 8bc0aa606fc7b900e00c7a2a0afe74edce0d481c694976833d63f110fe8dfc36 at 767 lines and cumulative notes SHA-256 f6edf74c04db895211a765be11fe8dd37416f7b19347f82adccb21b4cc8c3dcd at 5467 lines. Against current main c8ffe86ce931b5825271c317cf6bdf12898d10ea the scoped diff is 250 insertions and 23 deletions with clean diff-check. The complete V6 f6d57a to V7 diff is 20 append-only notes lines plus 22 insertions and 2 replacements in the plan, confined to the declared AudioSpan paragraph, structural laws, three-turn court, C1 row, and immediate-action wording.

The bytes accurately implement post-01M19BESFYY4RQTPNZFH0PX3BA and lead acceptance post-01M19BGHPZX844V01YKFVX3Z25. Plan 110-118 identifies AudioSpan as an unbound nonnegative millisecond overlay rather than a media coordinate; preserves explicit legacy emptiness and half-open lookup; requires exact 1/1000 local-axis binding plus a checked edition mapping; and keeps absent timing, legacy-empty timing, packet-duration unknown, and coordinate/mapping refusal distinct. Structural laws 535-539 and court 587-591 make those distinctions binding while preserving text, turn order, speaker, phase, prompt, support, lookup, endpoints, and binding-sensitive identity.

D2 is not weakened: the V6 native-coordinate, mapping, quantization, refusal, relation-identity, reverse, and decision-register text has no changed hunk. AxisIntervalSet remains nonempty, so preserving bound [t,t) endpoints is preservation of the legacy timing state, not authority to mint empty media support. C1 remains provider-free and gated behind P1 plus B0 at 721-724 and 759-766; no decoder, provider, package, media, runtime, worker, resolver, envelope migration, or new API is authorized.

History is preserved: current notes lines 1-5447 hash exactly to the approved V6 notes blob 4949b0852e1d09fbeaf6f673e05bc51e98bcfab9373fd06a6798ffcf44d89677, and section 121.7 is a literal EOF append. No edit, candidate operation, or runtime action was performed. I find no blocking or required amendment.
